name: genomecanvas
description: A free, open atlas of the human proteome in which any question becomes a replayable, sourced walkthrough.

scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run release:sample && corepack pnpm --filter @genomecanvas/web run dev
scripts.release:sample: cd forge && uv run --locked python -m forge.skeleton build --out ../apps/web/public/release/sample
scripts.e2e:install: corepack pnpm --filter @genomecanvas/web exec playwright install chromium
scripts.check: corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run format:check && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run budget
scripts.check:py: cd forge && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked mypy && uv run --locked pytest && uv run --locked python -m forge.ledger check
scripts.check:e2e: corepack pnpm run release:sample && corepack pnpm --filter @genomecanvas/web run build && corepack pnpm run e2e
scripts.check:all: corepack pnpm run check && corepack pnpm run check:py && corepack pnpm run check:e2e
